metaTitle: Fortnite Stats & Item Shop for Twitch | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Show Fortnite wins and K/D with !fn in Twitch chat, or the daily item shop with !itemshop. Set your Epic display name for season and stream stats.
title: Fortnite stats and the item shop in Twitch chat.
lead: Viewers type !fn for lifetime wins and K/D, !fn season for this season, or !itemshop for today's shop. Enable the free module and enter your Epic display name. !fn session tracks your stats for this stream.
howTitle: Link your Epic name and try !fn.
step1Desc: Switch on Fortnite Stats in the dashboard and enter your Epic display name as the default player. If it matches your Twitch username, you can leave the field blank.
step2Desc: Anyone can type !fn in chat. The bot replies with wins, matches, win rate, kills, K/D and your solo, duo and squad wins.
step3Desc: Each command has its own switch and message template in the dashboard. Keep the stats you want chat to see.
listTitle: Epic name, lookups and the item shop.
item1Desc: Use your Epic display name, including when you play on console. The bot looks up Epic names rather than PlayStation or Xbox names.
item2Desc: Viewers can check another player with !fn Ninja or !fn season Ninja. You can restrict player lookups to your linked account in the dashboard.
item3Desc: !fn session records your stats when you go live, then reports wins, kills and K/D for this stream. It always uses your linked account.
item4Desc: !itemshop and !fn store show today's shop items and prices with the date. Long lists end with a count of the remaining items.
limitsNote: The module is off by default. Each command has a 10 second cooldown, and season rollovers are tracked automatically.
faqQ1: How do I show my Fortnite stats in Twitch chat?
faqA1: Enable Fortnite Stats in the ItsBagelBot dashboard and enter your Epic display name as the default player. Viewers can then type !fn for lifetime wins, K/D and win rate, or !fn season for the current season.
faqQ2: How do I show the Fortnite item shop in chat?
faqA2: With Fortnite Stats enabled, type !itemshop or !fn store in Twitch chat. The bot posts today's shop items, prices and date. Long lists show a count of the remaining items. This command works without a linked player account.
faqQ3: Do I need my Epic name, or does a console name work?
faqA3: Use your Epic display name, even if you play on console. The bot supports Epic name lookups; PlayStation and Xbox names cannot be used for the lookup.
faqQ4: Is it free, and can I limit how often chat uses it?
faqA4: Yes. Fortnite Stats is included in the free plan. Each command has a 10 second cooldown, and you can switch individual commands off in the dashboard.
faqQ5: Where do the numbers come from?
faqA5: Player stats come from api-fortnite.com and the item shop from fortnite-api.com. You can edit the reply for each command in the dashboard.
legal: ItsBagelBot is not affiliated with or endorsed by Epic Games.
tblNote: These replies use the default templates with sample values. Player stats come from Fortnite accounts; the shop reply lists the daily rotation.
demoTitle: Checking stats and the item shop.
prereq1: Enable Fortnite Stats in the dashboard. The module is off by default.
prereq2: Your Epic display name for player stats. The item shop command works without it.
